sources: Equipment built in code for the project (src/ui/workouts/equipment.ts, materials.ts); dimensions from the standards and typical products named in each item's parts.source.
IPF Technical Rules (bench); IWF Technical and Competition Rules (bar, bumper plates); UK Approved Document K (stairs).
note: Coordinates in metres, prototype frame (y up, +z = the user's front, +x = the user's left), multiplied by the body scale s = pelvis rest height / 0.965 when placed. at = default position (prototype coords), yaw in degrees about y. Colliders: box {center, size, rx (degrees about x)} or capsule {a, b, r}; look = how the renderer draws it (steel, chrome, zinc, knurl, cushion, roller, grip, stack, none = drawn by the item recipe). The renderer draws these colliders as they are, so the mesh, the form checks and the surfaces agree. Surfaces: plane point + normal, u = in-plane axis, extent = half sizes along u and normal x u; points = the body points the surface carries. hinge: true = turned by adjust.angle about x through adjust.angle.pivot. equipmentProps = engine props an item implies when the record lists none.

items.name: Flat bench

parts.source: IPF Technical Rules: bench length at least 1.22 m, pad width 0.29-0.32 m, height 0.42-0.45 m from the floor; frame of 75 x 50 mm rectangular steel tube as on typical commercial flat benches.

items.note: Origin: floor under the pad centre; the pad runs along z (head end at -z). edge = the long side face (+x) for hip thrusts with the bench across the body (yaw 90).

items.name: Adjustable bench

parts.source: Typical commercial flat-incline-decline benches: pad height about 0.43-0.45 m, pad width 0.30 m, back pad about 0.85 m and seat about 0.34 m long, back from -15 (decline) to 85 degrees, wheels at the front foot.

items.note: Origin: floor under the hinge between seat (+z) and back pad (-z). angle rotates the back pad (hinge: true) about x through adjust.angle.pivot: positive raises the head end (incline), negative lowers it (decline).

items.name: Squat rack

parts.source: Typical power rack: 75 x 75 mm (3 x 3 in) 11-gauge steel uprights about 2.3 m tall, about 1.1 m between uprights, 25 mm holes at 51 mm (2 in) spacing, J-cups with plastic liners, pipe safeties.

items.note: Origin: floor at the rack centre; the lifter faces +z (out of the front). J-cups on the inside of the front uprights, cup floor at y 1.40; safeties at y 0.70.

items.name: Barbell

parts.source: IWF men's bar: 2.20 m long, 20 kg, 28 mm grip, 50 mm sleeves 415 mm long, 30 mm inner collars, knurl marks 0.81 m (powerlifting) apart; 20 kg bumper plates 450 mm diameter (IWF), about 60 mm thick on training bumpers; lever collars.

items.note: Origin: bar centre, bar along x (+x = the lifter's left). Follows the hands: centred between them, along the hand-to-hand line. Default at = resting on the floor (plates on the floor).

items.name: Dumbbells

parts.source: Typical 10 kg rubber hex dumbbell: 33 mm knurled chrome handle, about 130 mm between the heads, hex heads about 115 mm across flats and 65 mm long, overall about 0.26 m.

items.note: Origin: handle centre, handle along z. One dumbbell in each hand, turned with the hand. Default at = a pair resting on the floor.

items.name: Kettlebell

parts.source: Competition kettlebell (one size for every weight, 16 kg shown): about 280 mm tall, 210 mm body, 35 mm handle.

items.note: Origin: centre of the flat base. Follows the hands: the handle top sits between them and the bell hangs below.

items.name: Cable column

parts.source: Typical single-stack adjustable cable column: about 2.2 m tall, 0.6 x 0.65 m footprint, carriage on a front rail from about 0.25 to 2.0 m, 90 mm swivel pulley, 5 mm coated steel cable; attachments: D-handle, tricep rope (about 0.7 m), 0.5 m straight bar.

items.note: Origin: floor at the tower centre; the carriage and pulley face +z (yaw 180 turns them toward a lifter at the origin). height = pulley carriage height. The active attachment (parts.attachment) follows the hands with the cable from the pulley; the other attachments hang on the left upright. The carriage and attachment have no collider (they move).

items.name: Lat pulldown machine

parts.source: Typical selectorised lat pulldown: frame about 2.3-2.4 m tall, seat about 0.45-0.5 m, roller thigh pads, 1.2 m (48 in) lat bar with bent ends, 5 mm coated steel cable.

items.note: Origin: floor under the seat centre; the user sits facing +z toward the stack. The lat bar follows the hands on the cable from the top pulley. With no hands the bar hangs on its cable with the grips at hangY.

items.name: Leg press

parts.source: Typical plate-loaded 45 degree leg press: footprint about 2.1 x 1.6 m with plates, sled on two rails at 45 degrees, footplate about 0.75 x 0.6 m, back pad reclined, seat about 0.4 m, 20 kg iron plates (450 mm) on the sled horns.

items.note: Origin: floor under the pelvis; the user reclines facing +z, feet up the sled. The sled and footplate slide along the rails (railLeft/railRight) to the feet and have no collider. The engine prop legpress pushes along 35 degrees (loads.json); the rails here are 45 degrees as on real machines. With no feet the sled rests on its stops restT along the rails (legs nearly straight: the start position).

items.name: Leg extension machine

parts.source: Typical selectorised leg extension: seat about 0.5 m so the feet hang clear, knee in line with the cam axis, roller shin pad about 0.4 m below the axis, thigh hold-down roller, side weight stack about 1.5 m tall.

items.note: Origin: floor under the seat centre; the user sits facing +z, knees in line with the cam axis (x axis through y pivotY, z pivotZ). The lever and shin pad turn about that axis to the front of the ankles and have no collider.

items.name: Lying leg curl machine

parts.source: Typical selectorised prone leg curl: pad about 0.7 m high with the chest section angled down, knee in line with the cam axis, roller ankle pad about 0.4 m from the axis, front hand grips, side weight stack.

items.note: Origin: floor under the knee (cam) axis; the user lies prone with the head toward +z. The lever and ankle pad turn about the cam axis to the back of the ankles and have no collider.

items.name: Pull-up rig

parts.source: Typical free-standing pull-up station: 75 x 75 mm uprights, 32 mm (1.25 in) knurled bar about 1.3 m between uprights at 2.15 m (prototype bar height), braced feet about 1.3 m long.

items.note: Origin: floor under the bar centre; the bar runs along x at y 2.15.

items.name: Plyo box

parts.source: 3-in-1 plyo box, 20 x 24 x 30 in (0.51 x 0.61 x 0.76 m), 18 mm birch plywood with a dark rubberised finish, bare ply edges, routed hand holds and a non-slip rubber top; standing on its 0.51 m side.

items.note: Origin: floor under the box centre.

items.name: Exercise mat

parts.source: Exercise mat 183 x 61 cm, 15 mm closed-cell NBR foam, rounded edges.

items.note: Origin: floor under the mat centre; the mat runs along z.

items.name: Resistance band

parts.source: Flat latex loop band 41 in (1.04 m flat length, a closed loop), about 40 mm wide, about 1 mm thick, matte (light, red); held with about 0.6 m free between the hands, each end wrapped once round the fist (loopR = fist radius).

items.note: Origin: midway between the hands. Two strands run from hand to hand and sag when the hands are closer than the band length.

objects.name: Chair

parts.source: Typical dining chair: seat 0.45 m high, 0.44 x 0.42 m, back 0.85 m high, 35 mm legs.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the seat centre; the sitter faces +z.

objects.name: Step (first)

parts.source: UK Approved Document K: rise at most 220 mm, going at least 220 mm on a private stair; 180 mm rise and 280 mm going is a common comfortable step; 0.8 m wide.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the tread centre. The prototype stair (step1 then step2 behind it).

objects.name: Step (second)

parts.source: UK Approved Document K: rise at most 220 mm, going at least 220 mm on a private stair; 180 mm rise and 280 mm going is a common comfortable step; 0.8 m wide.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the tread centre. The prototype stair (step1 then step2 behind it).

objects.name: Box

parts.source: Typical small cardboard moving or book box, 360 x 220 x 260 mm (the prototype size), double-wall kraft board, hand slots on the two short sides, taped lid seam.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the box centre. Held by the two hand slots; follows the hands (level, turned with the hand line).

objects.name: Bucket

parts.source: Typical 12 L plastic bucket: about 285 mm across the top, 225 mm across the base, 265 mm high, 3 mm wall, steel wire bail with a plastic grip sleeve; drawn full of water.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the bucket centre. One grip: the bail top, followed by the right hand; the bucket hangs straight down.

objects.name: Shopping bag

parts.source: Typical cotton canvas tote with groceries (a loaf, a bottle): 340 mm wide, 340 mm high, 180 mm deep, two 25 mm webbing handles that meet in the hand 0.52 m above the floor.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the bag centre. One grip: the handles, followed by the right hand; the bag hangs straight down. Use two for a split carry.

objects.name: Child (simplified)

parts.source: Stylised child figure, labelled simplified: 0.95 m tall, about 14 kg (WHO Child Growth Standards: a 36-month-old is about 95-96 cm and 14 kg at the median), held under the arms.

objects.note: SIMPLIFIED: a stylised figure (capsules and spheres), not an anatomical child. Origin: floor under the child standing. Held under the armpits; follows the hands, legs hanging.

objects.name: Suitcase

parts.source: Typical medium hard-shell spinner suitcase: about 0.66 m tall including wheels and handle, 0.42 m wide, 0.26 m deep, carried by the top handle.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the case. The wide face is along z (against the leg when carried at the side). One grip: the top handle, followed by the right hand; hangs straight down.

objects.name: Gas cylinder

parts.source: Typical 13 kg domestic butane cylinder, generic colour and no branding: about 310 mm across, 590 mm high with collar and valve (makers vary by a few millimetres), steel, collar handle.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the cylinder axis. One grip: the collar rail, followed by the right hand; hangs straight down.

objects.name: Chest of drawers

parts.source: Typical four-drawer chest of drawers, 0.90 m wide, 1.05 m high, 0.45 m deep; the push or pull edge is the top front at hand height (prototype hands 1.0 m).

objects.note: Origin: floor under the carcass centre. The user faces +z; the front face is at z = 0.4 (at 0.625 minus half the depth).

objects.name: Mop

parts.source: Typical flat microfibre mop: 1.30 m aluminium handle, 22 mm diameter, foam grip sleeve, 0.40 x 0.12 m swivel head.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the head centre; the stick runs up +y. Follows the hands: the head stays on the floor, the stick leans from the head to the hands.

objects.name: Broom

parts.source: Typical household broom: 1.40 m beech handle, 24 mm diameter, 0.30 m wide brush with 0.12 m synthetic bristles.

objects.note: Origin: floor under the brush centre; the handle runs up +y. Follows the hands like the mop.
